title: Get all Next of kins Route

cues.en: Now that we're done with this service in our Next of kin folder, we're going to create an old file where we shall define the route to get all the next of kins belonging to the user.
cues.zh: 服務完成後，在 next_of_kin 資料夾建立 all 檔案，定義取得使用者所有近親資料的路由。

cues.en: As you can open the Project Explorer, then you're going to go to backend app API routes.
cues.zh: 開啟專案檔案總管，進入 backend/app/api/routes。

cues.en: Then within next of kin we're going to create a new file that's going to be all dot pi.
cues.zh: 在 next_of_kin 裡建立 all.py。

cues.en: Then let me see.
We can copy the inputs from create dot pi.
cues.zh: 可以從 create.py 複製匯入。

cues.en: Then we'll just make some changes.
So let me just copy all these inputs.
Come back to all dot pi, paste it in then let me see.
cues.zh: 回到 all.py 貼上，再看看。

cues.en: We're going to import API router depends HTTP exception and status.
Then async session then current user then our logger.
Then.
Now from our services we're now going to import not create next of kin.
cues.zh: 從 services 匯入的不再是 create_next_of_kin。

cues.en: This is going to be get user next of kins then the logger.
Then for the schema we're going to just import the next of kin read schema like that.
Then let's define this route so you can see logger.
cues.zh: 接著定義路由，先設定 logger。

cues.en: That's going to be get getlogger.
Then for the router, that's going to be the router.
The prefix that's going to be slash next hyphen of then hyphen king.
Then we can see router dot get.
The path is going to be slash all.
Then the response model that's going to be we want to have a list that has a response that abides to the next of kin.
cues.zh: response_model 是清單，其中回應依循 NextOfKin。

cues.en: Read schema.
Then the status code that's going to be status dot HTTP 200.
Okay.
Then we're going to add a description for this.
And you can say get all next of kin for the authenticated user like that.
cues.zh: 寫「取得已驗證使用者的所有近親資料」。

cues.en: Then the function to be called is going to be async define list underscore next of kin.
cues.zh: 要呼叫的函式是 async def list_next_of_kin。

cues.en: That's going to take in the current user pass in the current user.
Then the session that's going to be the async session.
And you can say depends on get session.
Then this function is going to return a list of next of kin read schema.
cues.zh: 函式會回傳 NextOfKinReadSchema 清單。

cues.en: Then as usual, we're going to have our try block and the first order of business is going to be to get the next of kins for the user using our service function.
cues.zh: 一樣建立 try 區塊，先使用服務函式取得使用者的近親資料。

cues.en: And so you can say next underscore of kins that's going to be await.
Get user next of kins passing in the user ID.
And that's going to be the current user's ID.
cues.zh: 值為目前使用者的 ID。

cues.en: So current user.id.
And then the session that's going to be a session.
Then we're going to return the next of kins as a list of read schemas.
cues.zh: 接著將近親資料以 ReadSchema 清單回傳。

cues.en: So you can say return as a list next of kin read schemas.
cues.zh: 回傳清單，其中使用 NextOfKinReadSchema。

cues.en: Then we're going to chain model validate.
Then we're going to pass in the kin.
And then we can use list comprehension to convert this next of kin instances to next of kin read schema.
cues.zh: 使用串列生成式，將 NextOfKin 實例轉成 NextOfKinReadSchema。

cues.en: As you can see for the kin in next of kins like that.
So basically at this point we're just returning the kins as a list of read schemas.
cues.zh: 這裡就是把近親資料以 ReadSchema 清單回傳。

cues.en: That's why we're implementing list comprehension right here.
Then our accept block.
So what I can do is let me go to create dot pi and you can copy the accept blocks, both of them, then paste it right there.
cues.zh: 到 create.py，複製兩個 except 區塊，再貼在這裡。

cues.en: Make sure the indentation is correct, then accept HTTP exception has HTTP exception.
cues.zh: 確認縮排正確，接著 except HTTPException as http_exc。

cues.en: We can get rid of the logger.
We just raise the HTTP exception then except exception as e.
cues.zh: 直接重新拋出 HTTPException；接著 except Exception as e。

cues.en: We're going to log by saying this changes to failed to retrieve next of kin for the user.
cues.zh: 記錄訊息改為「無法取得這位使用者的近親資料」。

cues.en: Then you're going to pass in the user's email by saying current user dot email.
cues.zh: 再用 current_user.email 帶入使用者電子郵件。

cues.en: Then we can just pass in the error like that.
Then for the HTTP exception status code is 500, detail status is error.
cues.zh: HTTPException 狀態碼為 500，detail 中 status 為 error。

cues.en: The message is going to be failed to retrieve next of kins.
cues.zh: message 為「無法取得近親資料」。

cues.en: Then we could have an action and here we can say please try again later.
cues.zh: 也可以加入 action，寫「請稍後再試」。

cues.en: Then you save the file.
That's it for this lecture.
In the next lecture we shall add the route to our main.py file.
cues.zh: 下一堂把路由加入 main.py。

cues.en: Then test the route out.
